title: PR #238: test(atc-node): avoid sampled-height race in multi-node E2E
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

## Summary

- Replace sequential sampled-height equality assertions with a comparison of the nodes' common finalized block ID.
- Apply the same invariant after node recovery, where exact current heights are also sampled at different times.
- Preserve the consensus safety assertion: nodes must agree on the block ID at their shared finalized height.

## Evidence / status

The failure is recorded in [Blockchain Core Integration run 40558112652](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/actions/runs/40558112652). The test waits for node A and then node B while both continue producing blocks at a one-second interval; the observed heights were 3 and 2. This patch addresses the invalid timing-sensitive assertion, but it is **not verified until CI reruns the affected test and E2E jobs**. If the shared finalized block IDs disagree, the test will still fail and indicate a substantive divergence.

No production consensus code changed. Do not merge until the exact-head checks pass and the test behavior is reviewed.
